name: Captain Hooktusk
guide_text: In the early game, hero power 1 drop battlecries such as [[Southsea Busker||98501]]. Later, hero power mainly used to target high tier battlecries such as [[Rodeo Performer||104466]] for the discovery.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up first when it costs 5-7 gold. Try to hero power battlecry 5 drops or 4 drops with the buddy, such as [[Rodeo Performer||104466]].
